_help: Which of Shalone's drawings goes in which PICO-8 sprite slot. Each frame takes the next slot (2 frames fill N and N+1; a 16x16 drawing is 2 slots wide and 2 tall). Swap a name when she draws the real one, then: npm run pico8. Slots not listed are left alone, so things drawn in PICO-8's own editor stay.
_slots: 0 priest idle, 2 bishop idle, 4 deacon idle, 6 priest walk, 8 priest blessing (4 frames), 12 bishop walk, 14 deacon walk, 16-27 people walking (6 bases), 37 grace (a heart, 4 frames), 46 child standing, 48 child walking, 33 gift box, 34 rosary, 35 holy water bucket, 36 coffee, 41-43 bushes, 44 lilies (spring), 45 pumpkin (fall), 56 bishop blessing (4 frames), 84 angel (4 frames), 96 car and 104 parish van (her first car) (16x16, 4 frames each), 72-83 people standing (6 bases, same order as walking), characters to unlock (standing, walking): 28/30 benedictine, 60/62 dominican, 64/66 franciscan, 68/70 eastern monk, 88/90 cardinal, 92/94 pope, 50 java priest, 52 saintly priest (her 2-frame drawings; walking uses the same)
_big: Her 32x32 art: the first 8 on the bottom half of the sprite sheet, the rest stored in the code and unpacked at start into an extra sprite sheet (upper memory). Order is fixed: add new ones at the end.
_parts: Per group, which of her colors the game swaps for each one. people: every person gets random hair, skin (with matching eyes) and clothes. priest: the bishop's priests get their own skin and eyes. deacon: new deacons get their own skin and eyes; 'vestment' follows the season (spring white, summer green, fall green, winter purple). child: the baby at a baptism gets its own hair, skin and clothes. p1-p7: each playable character's own look, picked on the start screen with up/down (in chars order: priest, benedictine, dominican, franciscan, eastern monk, cardinal, pope). skin: peach, tan or brown. hair: yellow only with peach skin; brown, dark blue, gray, white with any (never the skin's own color). eyes: blue, green or dark blue with peach skin, dark blue otherwise. beard (eastern monk): white or dark gray. white: always white (the pope's hair). The benedictine changes skin and eyes only; the dominican's hair is also his cappa, so his hair stays.
_tops: People slots whose top row (the top of the head) is hair or a hat: each person gets one at random.
_colors: Force one of her colors onto a PICO-8 color number (0-15) when the nearest match is wrong or two colors land on the same one. #1D2B53 (the priest's and deacon's hair) goes to 2, its own color, so hair can change apart from the black cassock.
_separate: Colors forced above only so a part can be swapped apart from the same color elsewhere (the priest's hair from his cassock, the benedictine's eyes from his habit): their own look shows them as their nearest PICO-8 color.
